discovery_target: Previously unreported coordination in which distinguishable autonomous participants transfer a task result, instruction or artifact, the recipient demonstrably uses it, and primary evidence shows that the coordination crossed an operator-defined boundary.
selection: Completed the exact three-record non-platform `cohort` cursor, then inspected every still-uninspected exact-ID comparison absence in the saved `openai` listing family and the sole remaining `oai`-only match. A cross-snapshot hash join then selected the only three untouched comparison absences whose decoded hashes matched already inspected artifacts without listing-visible known-family domains. The original reads exposed known Amap references in all three. This is bounded original-record coverage, not participant attribution or a novelty claim.
snapshot_limitations: The sanitized snapshots preserve original public report links, separate event and observation times, original-report hashes, decoded-artifact hashes, domain-level traffic and bounded static-operation counts. They omit submitted paths and query values, request and response bodies, headers, submitter identifiers and recovered source. A shared hash, provider-owned hostname or successful POST does not authenticate an autonomous participant or establish task-result use.

assessed_groups.assessment: The three non-Appwrite/non-Facebook matches are an ordinary job-listing page with analytics, a Shopify storefront with platform telemetry, and an event site redirecting into Cvent assets. All have zero decoded characters, static fetch/XHR/socket/response-read/task-peer operations, channel references and state references. The saved listing term was only a text locator; it did not identify a shared cohort.
assessed_groups.classification: three ordinary-web keyword collisions; no sender, recipient or task artifact

assessed_groups.assessment: Thirty-one unrelated commercial pages contain both the documented advertising-measurement script and event hosts; one additional storefront records only the event POST, consistent with a partial or cached pixel load. One redirect record loads an OpenAI-themed site and public OpenAI/ChatGPT assets. Two records contain no provider host at all. Across all thirty-five records there is no decoded carrier, static task/peer or response-read operation, channel, shared state or source-level transfer edge. Provider infrastructure is visible, but provider model execution is not.
assessed_groups.classification: advertising-measurement, public-site and keyword-collision controls; not model activity

assessed_groups.assessment: The sole `oai`-only remainder redirects to a parked-domain marketplace and Cloudflare challenge traffic. It contains no provider hostname, decoded artifact, task operation, channel or state reference.

The two short artifacts were reused across HTTP-test carriers, but enhanced submitted-reference extraction exposes Amap, Alibaba or related proxy references in every newly inspected record. The matching captures contain zero static fetch, XHR, socket, response-read or task/peer operations in the decoded artifacts; some captures execute only the carrier request while others reach the already excluded Amap/Alibaba footprint. Artifact equality therefore reflects wrapper reuse within a known family, not a demonstrated sender-to-recipient task handoff.
assessed_groups.classification: known Amap-family wrapper reuse; not a distinct population or new coordination episode

assessed_groups.assessment: No record preserves a task-bearing artifact from an independently attributable autonomous sender that a later distinguishable autonomous recipient acquires and causally uses. The strongest cross-record link is identical tiny wrapper text already tied to the excluded Amap family. No operator-boundary evidence survives inspection.
assessed_groups.classification: negative bounded cursor result; no candidate and no claim that the wider backlog is disproven

raw_artifact_locator_searches.method: Global GitHub default-branch file search used only to locate committed event artifacts; no repository code, test or agent runtime was executed.
raw_artifact_locator_searches.assessment: The sixty returned excerpts are implementation code, schemas, protocol definitions, documentation, examples, fixtures or synthetic tests for intentional agent systems. None is a committed real-run sender-to-recipient event record with observable downstream use, so no excerpt was promoted as evidence or subjected to a novelty claim. This is a bounded locator result, not proof that no such artifact exists elsewhere.

evidence_state.provider_attribution: OpenAI advertising and public-site infrastructure is visible, but no provider-model execution or autonomous AI participant is established

novelty_check: All forty-two selected report IDs are absent from the pinned comparison release, but exact-ID absence is only a dataset fact. The Amap and provider-measurement records match existing exclusions or controls. Because no AI transfer-and-use chain exists in the other records, no broad prior-reporting search for a purported swarm was warranted and no novelty claim is made.
advancement_evidence: Any trail in this batch advances only if an already public original artifact identifies a specific autonomous AI sender and task-bearing result or instruction, a distinguishable recipient that later acquires and causally uses it, and primary provenance showing that the cooperation exceeded an operator-defined authorization boundary. A provider hostname, repeated hash, redirect, POST status, scanner label or exact-ID comparison absence does not qualify.

next_cursor.advancement_evidence: A record advances only if its existing public report JSON preserves a task-bearing artifact from an independently attributable autonomous AI sender, a distinguishable recipient acquisition and dependent action, and primary evidence that the cooperation crossed authorization. Redirects, frames, repeated assets and test-service traffic do not qualify by themselves.

safety: Only existing public scanner report JSON and public default-branch GitHub search excerpts were read. No carrier, referenced destination, live target, recovered code, response body, payload, package, scan, runtime, account, authentication route, message, vote or participant contact was opened, invoked, executed, submitted or replayed. Publication omits raw carrier and request URLs, paths, query values, bodies, headers, credentials, submitter identifiers, personal addresses and private logs.
